answer: Vesting with clawback turns sybil nectar sour. First, every reward an agent earns is locked and vests evenly over 60 days. Second, a weekly beacon round publishes fresh cluster flags from graders. Third, any flagged account loses all its unvested coins, which flow back to honest miners. Fourth, cleared accounts keep vesting. A farm of 500 fakes paying $0.04 per answer for 240 epochs sinks $4,800 and four GPU-months, then can lose two months of pay in one sweep. It's like a vine that only fruits after a full season, with a guard checking every basket at the gate.
